skill_name: Design a system for food delivery using AI.
workflow: The AI-based food delivery system will utilize computer vision and image recognition technology to identify food items on the menu. Utilizing natural language processing, the system will be able to interpret customer requests and populate the appropriate order forms. Machine learning algorithms will be used to monitor order trends, suggest optimal delivery routes and track order fulfillment.
